The answer rests on the current evidence set; it could change with new publications. --- ### Concrete Test to Verify the Answer 1. **Action:** Use the approved `public-search` tool with the query: `"Pitt Rivers Museum" "Naga" "remains" "39" site:bbc.com OR site:reuters.com OR site:theguardian.com` (limit results to the three target outlets). 2. **Expected result if the answer is correct:** - At least one article from each outlet appears, all stating that **39** remains were returned. - No article from those outlets mentions any number other than 39. 3. **Failure condition:** - An article from any of the three outlets reports a different count (e.g., 38, 40, “around 40”). - No article from one of the outlets mentions the return at all (indicating the claim may be unsupported by that outlet). Running this targeted search will directly confirm whether independent public news outlets uniformly report the figure 39 and whether any divergent number exists.
